Machine Room now runs the Arrays & Memory learning pilot as a Windows desktop app.

- Four original lessons, executable examples, three diagram exercises, and two reversible conceptual models.
- Three editable C17 lab packages and a two-file sensor-data project, graded locally against the verified fixtures.
- Persistent drafts, hints, review cards, immutable attempt history, and a version-bound chapter unlock after passing checks and explicit self-review.
- Real Open Lab execution, live output, cancellation, deadlines, bounded output, and Windows process-tree cleanup.
- Matching dark editor scrollbars and no editor focus rectangle.

The small installer reuses installed WebView2. Setup requires internet only if that runtime is absent; learning works offline. Install a local C17-capable GCC or Clang, or configure its executable in Open Lab. The compiler is not bundled or downloaded automatically. C execution uses your Windows privileges and is not a security sandbox.

This is a learning pilot, not all 24 chapters. It assumes loops/functions and basic compilation. Other chapters remain outlines; unlocking Strings & input does not create its course content. Optional AddressSanitizer evidence remains unavailable on the verified local MinGW profile. R04's comprehensive polish/accessibility audit is the next task.
